gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-cypro-m: Bruno Ace SC spreads its letters out like beads on a thread. Its single flat line weight sets off Noto Sans Cypro Minoan, whose plain sans terminals are cut back to leave big gaps.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Noto Sans Hatran reads easily, its wide-throated e opening like a funnel beneath the tube-like Bruno Ace SC heading. Pipe-thick display letters sit above, with funnel-open sans text running below.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-inscrip: Bent-pipe strokes, spread wide, make Bruno Ace SC loud, flat and unmistakable. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi handles the small stuff, keeping every tiny counter unclogged in plain sans text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-manicha: Noto Sans Manichaean reads clean and modern, with open-mouthed e crossbars. Text below the Bruno Ace SC heading would flow lightly, a sans-serif texture that keeps its crossbars open page after page.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-old-sou: Round, flat, unhurried: Bruno Ace SC draws its bowls with no swelling or thinning. Noto Sans Old South Arabian brings friendly sans curves that end before they turn inward.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ojuju: Constant pen line, beaded spacing, and no hesitation anywhere: that's Bruno Ace SC. Ojuju handles the softer side, plain sans strokes with a mellow range of weights and wide, barely curled s curves.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-pontano-sans: Bruno Ace SC holds one unchanging pen pressure and angle across every beaded, widely spaced letter. Pontano Sans keeps its c terminals broad and inviting, a contemporary sans counterweight.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-quattrocento-sans: Neatly bent pipe-cleaner letters, spread out like beads on a thread. Give Bruno Ace SC generous size, and let Quattrocento Sans keep each c from ever looking like an o.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-rethink-sans: Rethink Sans keeps its openings generous at every weight. Beneath the beaded display letters of Bruno Ace SC, its sans-serif strokes stay uniform, approachable and modern on the page.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-sarabun: Bruno Ace SC turns every corner without a pressure swell. Sarabun brings a wide channel into every bowl, giving this sans a clean, approachable counterweight to all that expressive flatness.
